name: @stateful-mcp/macro-cli
description: Generic terminal UI for the Stateful macro workspace

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target bun --format esm --external '*.node' --external 'ink' --external 'react' --external 'react-devtools-core' --external 'react-reconciler' --external 'scheduler' && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
